# SI Console

> Private project repo for SI Console, a Raspberry Pi 5 physical console for supervising AI agents (Hack Club Fallen). All content is DRAFT; the R3 drawings are reference only.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): human front page, team, status, open decisions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents, source of truth, what not to edit
- [INDEX.json](INDEX.json): machine-readable manifest with status and owner
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): dated revision log

## Docs
- [docs/decisions.md](docs/decisions.md): case, mini screen, model router decisions and the 5 open R3 review items
- [docs/GPIO_PIN_MAP.md](docs/GPIO_PIN_MAP.md): the only GPIO map plus ULN2003 wiring and resistor math (Rev R2)

## Bill of materials
- [bom/BOM.csv](bom/BOM.csv): the only current BOM, Rev R2.1 with both cuts, 791.33 CAD fundable
- [bom/BOM_NOTES.md](bom/BOM_NOTES.md): totals and the cuts applied

## Blueprints (R3, reference only)
- [blueprints/2d/case-panels-R3.png](blueprints/2d/case-panels-R3.png): case panel drawings
- [blueprints/2d/electrical-schematic-R3.png](blueprints/2d/electrical-schematic-R3.png): electrical schematic

- [blueprints/2d/connection-diagram-R3.png](blueprints/2d/connection-diagram-R3.png): system connection diagram
- [blueprints/3d/render-hero-R3.png](blueprints/3d/render-hero-R3.png): hero render
- [blueprints/3d/render-exploded-R3.png](blueprints/3d/render-exploded-R3.png): exploded view
- [blueprints/3d/render-front-R3.png](blueprints/3d/render-front-R3.png): front view
- [blueprints/3d/render-top-R3.png](blueprints/3d/render-top-R3.png): top view
